title: Provenance
description: Who put an entry here and when. Stamped by the submission workflow; leave it out when writing an entry by hand and a maintainer adds it.

submittedBy.description: The GitHub login that submitted the entry.

dateAdded.description: When the entry first landed, YYYY-MM-DD. Kept across edits.

dateModified.description: When the entry last changed, YYYY-MM-DD.
